patch.value: Train the bounded LM in external Compose jobs across recursive generations
Reuse durable process ownership, reservations, receipts and recovery for bounded causal LM fits in isolated resource-limited containers; retain held-out evaluation and promotion in the controller.

Two real generations with successor collection; SIGKILL recovery, cancellation, corrupt checkpoint and limit refusals, one-launch contention; behavioural revert proofs and unchanged npm and Bun release gates.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Design: extend the existing process contract with a typed LM payload and checkpoint validator; share owner fences, atomic reservation, staged adoption, cancellation and settlement. Keep held-out examples in the controller. Bind immutable image, memory and CPU ceilings into programme and job identity; send only frozen weights, source adapter, training strings and collected rewards to a networkless non-root container. Add real recursive generations and crash/cancellation/limit/contention drills, then behavioural revert proofs and unchanged release gates.
